derivation: neuter of a compound of G3844 (παρά) and the base of G4139 (πλησίον) (as adverb);

occurrences.text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
